description: Get a list of users with their access levels to a room.

filters.description: The filters to apply to the room security info.

count.description: The number of items to be retrieved or processed.

items.description:
The fields to include in the response.

access - The access rights type.
sharedTo - The user who has the access to the specified file.
isLocked - Specifies if the access right is locked or not.
isOwner - Specifies if the user is an owner of the specified file or not.
canEditAccess - Specifies if the user can edit the access to the specified file or not.
subjectType - The subject type.

filterType.description:
The filter type of the access rights.

0 - User or group
1 - Invitation link
2 - External link
4 - Additional external link
8 - Primary external link
16 - User
32 - Group

filterValue.description: The text filter value used for filtering room security information.

startIndex.description: The starting index of the items to retrieve in a paginated request.

roomId.description: The ID of the room to get a list of users with their access level for.
